summary_1line: Vyasa explains the four stages of life—student, householder, forest recluse, and renunciate—and details duties, especially the discipline and ethics of students and householders.

image_candidates.scene_text: A young disciple at dawn gently touches his teacher’s feet with upturned palms while standing humbly beside the hermitage fire.
A forest hermit in bark garments lives on fruits and roots beneath tall trees, meditating alone on the knowledge of Brahman.
A householder serves food to wandering Brahmins and guests before eating the humble remnants himself in a simple fire-lit home.
